# あげる・くれる・もらう — giving and receiving

**[あげる (main verb)](<../grammar/あげる・くれる・もらう.md#あげる>)**
:   Giving from the giver's side: (私が)友達に本をあげた。The subject passes the thing outward; when you are the one receiving, switch to もらう.

**[もらう (main verb)](<../grammar/あげる・くれる・もらう.md#もらう>)**
:   Receiving from the receiver's side — the getter is the subject: 友達に本をもらった。Choose it when the getting is the point, not the giving.

**[てあげる](<../grammar/てあげる・てくれる・てもらう.md#てあげる>)**
:   Doing a favor FOR someone, from the doer's side: 荷物を持ってあげた。Careful upward — it can sound like claiming credit; prefer humble forms with superiors.

**[てくれる](<../grammar/てあげる・てくれる・てもらう.md#てくれる>)**
:   Someone does something for you or your in-group — the DOER is the subject: 先生が説明してくれた。The benefit flows toward you; carries a note of gratitude.

**[てもらう (service)](<../grammar/てあげる・てくれる・てもらう.md#てもらう>)**
:   You receive the favor — the RECEIVER is the subject and often arranged it: 先生に説明してもらった。The same event as てくれる, told from your side.
